$comment: One Outlook conversation, read from both of its sources. The mail archive reader (frontends/aiq_api/src/aiq_api/mail_archive/reader.py) returns PR_CONVERSATION_INDEX (0x0071) base64-encoded as `conversationIndexBase64`, the same text an inbound mail's Thread-Index header carries; the BFF derives the conversation GUID from either with ONE function, threadIndexGuid in frontends/ui/src/lib/mail-thread/mail-threading.ts (MS-OXOMSG 2.2.1.3: bytes 6..21, lower-case hex in byte order, 8-4-4-4-12). test_mail_archive_reader.py holds the reader to `bytesHex` -> `conversationIndexBase64`, mail-threading.spec.ts holds threadIndexGuid to `conversationIndexBase64` -> `guid` and to `childOfBase64` (a reply in the same conversation) -> the same `guid`. A GUID formatted anywhere else (Python's uuid.UUID(bytes_le=...) swaps the first three groups) would never match an inbound mail to its archived conversation.
